policy: Documentary source review is distinct from independent qualified signoff. External human review is required for consequential prescriptive or site-specific regulated judgments, not as a blanket gate for attributed reporting. Exact-revision claim findings and conditional triggers are recorded in editorial/reviews/LAUNCH-CLAIM-RESOLUTION-2026-11-11.json. Zero qualified independent signoffs; no release authorization.
